Subject: Vendr/Whistic bridge onboarding for HelixPay — initial deliverables

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses yesterday. HelixPay is ready to move from the discovery phase into a bridged onboarding where Vendr will push a canonical profile into Whistic on their behalf. To make the sync smooth we need two things from Redwood before the kickoff: a completed mapping template (I attached the Vendr mapping template) and a short matrix that designates temporary upload owners for SOC 2 evidence (who at Redwood will actually upload each artifact).

High-level asks:
- Confirm whether Redwood prefers Vendr to perform the Whistic push or if Redwood will do a manual upload to Whistic after Vendr populates the canonical record.
- Provide the temporary owner matrix (name + email + role) for uploads + an expected window (2 business days is fine).
- Share any evidence retention constraints (HelixPay requires 24 months minimum for some audit artifacts).

Attachments: vendr-onboard-mapping-template.xlsx (worksheet: field_map), example-presign-pol.txt (stub)

We can pilot with a limited set of items (SOC 2 report + CAIQ snapshot + KMS rotation proof) to minimize churn. Proposed kickoff: Mon Mar 6 2028 10:00am PT — please confirm.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Torres
Partner Onboarding — Vendr
sofia.torres@vendr.com

--
Note: For audit readiness we recommend bundling presigned evidence for all S3-hosted artifacts (we used that approach with Brightleaf).

Thanks Sofia 99for the clear checklist. Well run the small pilot and confirm owners.

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood prefers Vendr to perform the canonical push into Whistic for the pilot; well validate the record and then take ownership for ongoing maintenance. That avoids bumping into our SSO provisioning window.
- Ill own coordination on the Redwood side for evidence assignment but will nominate temporary upload owners.
- Retention constraints acknowledged (24 months for audit logs; HelixPay-specific PII handling noted).

Action items for Redwood before kickoff (Mar 6):
1) I will return a completed mapping sheet (Vendr template) by end of day Mar 2.
2) Marissa, can you produce the temporary owner matrix and confirm who can presign S3 artifacts?
3) Marissa / Jonas, please check whether any artifacts are stored in customer-managed buckets (HelixPay asked about that).

If Mar 6 10am PT works for Sofia / Alice well lock it. Otherwise propose Mar 7 AM.

-Rishi
